articles.title: Circle, Nomura eye Japan corporate FX with stablecoin settlement: Report
articles.summary: Circle and Nomura are reportedly partnering to enable stablecoin-based foreign exchange settlement for Japanese companies as the country's regulated blockchain-based financial infrastructure expands.

articles.title: Indonesia sets certification rules for influencers recommending crypto
articles.summary: Indonesia’s financial regulator will require influencers recommending crypto and other digital assets to hold relevant certifications as regulators worldwide tighten oversight of finfluencers.

articles.title: Polish crypto exchange Kanga secures MiCA license in Latvia
articles.summary: Poland-founded crypto exchange Kanga has secured a Class 3 MiCA license in Latvia, enabling EU-wide crypto services as Polish lawmakers debate framework's implementation.

articles.title: House Democrats seek SEC answers on AI investment advisers
articles.summary: House Democrats have questioned the SEC over trading platforms offering AI agent advisers making “consequential investment decisions on behalf of retail investors.”

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: FTX exec’s wife scheduled for November trial on campaign finance charges
articles.summary: A Manhattan judge ordered that Michelle Bond’s criminal trial start in November after he denied a motion to dismiss the indictment based on claims that prosecutors misled her husband over her charges.

articles.title: Bitcoin nearly loses $59K as DXY surges: Are traders bracing for more pain?
articles.summary: Bitcoin drops toward new 2026 lows as spot BTC ETF outflows and slowing accumulation from Strategy weigh on market sentiment.

articles.title: Crypto-backed candidates notch wins in three US state primaries
articles.summary: The crypto-aligned Fairshake PAC and its affiliates spent a combined $8 million on media to support candidates in Maryland, New York and Utah amid pushback from many criticizing “crypto billionaires.”

articles.title: Bitcoin falls under $60K, but traders anticipate 15% bounce
articles.summary: Bitcoin price dropped below $60,000 for the first time in weeks, but data shows traders betting on a relief bounce.

articles.title: Bitcoin crash to $60K opens new $530M demand zone: Will bulls buy in?
articles.summary: A $525 million Bitcoin buy wall intersects with a major liquidation zone, creating a key battleground between $60,500 and $65,000.

articles.title: Binance withdraws Greece-filed MiCA application
articles.summary: Binance said it plans to seek authorization in another EU jurisdiction just days ahead of the July 1 MiCA deadline, as unlicensed crypto firms are expected to wind down activities in the bloc.

articles.title: The Impossibility of Perfect Fairness in Transaction Ordering
articles.summary: Why perfect fairness cannot hold in asynchronous networks, and how different blockchains adopt different relaxations to fairness.

articles.title: DeFi TVL drops 39% in 2026 amid market downturn and record hack activity
articles.summary: DeFi TVL fell 39% in 2026 as a broader market downturn and fallout from major exploits, including the Kelp DAO hack, weighed on the sector.

articles.title: SecondFi traces Cardano wallet exploit to address-level issue
articles.summary: Cardano wallet SecondFi traced the incident to an address-level issue and secured 129 million ADA after attackers drained funds from 374 addresses.

articles.title: CryptoQuant warns on Strategy's dividend coverage as cash reserve falls 38%
articles.summary: Strategy's cash reserves are now enough to pay only 14 months of dividends from the previous seven-year level. CryptoQuant said the company should pause Bitcoin purchases and rebuild its reserves.

articles.title: Aave positioned to capture tokenized asset growth in DeFi: Standard Chartered
articles.summary: Standard Chartered said tokenized assets moving into DeFi could drive deposits into Aave and help the protocol rebuild its position as a dominant onchain lending platform.

articles.title: BTC price four-year trend calls for $76K as analysis says Bitcoin 'not broken'
articles.summary: Bitcoin research said that BTC price action remained in tune with previous cycles as the bear market produces a 20% discount to its four-year "adoption structure" trend line.

articles.title: South Korea adds token securities to capital market overhaul
articles.summary: South Korea’s Financial Services Commission has placed token securities infrastructure within a wider capital-market modernization plan covering faster settlement, longer trading hours and digital transformation.

articles.title: OpenPayd secures MiCA license as stablecoin adoption grows in Europe
articles.summary: OpenPayd, which provides infrastructure to companies including Kraken crypto exchange, can now offer regulated crypto services across Europe under MiCA.
